S0218: The first state is: 'I do not yet know.' This is not weakness. It is epistemic honesty.
S0256: Zero: The Quranic equivalent is close to Al-Ḥaqq. The stable truth/reference ... This resonates with your Zero principle.
S0262: A trustworthy knowledge system must not only accumulate knowledge; it must reduce the distortions that prevent knowledge from being correctly understood.
Witness Consciousness / Zero Lens ... Events change, Knowledge states change, Reference remains. This is exactly your Zero idea.
S0274: Can a sufficiently powerful system completely describe and validate itself from inside itself? The answer: No. A system cannot be the complete judge of itself. ... KnowledgeOS needs an outside reference.
S0286: Do not store all knowledge. Store: Identity rules, Transformation rules, Evidence rules, Reasoning rules.
S0310: the biggest discovery: UNKNOWN is more important than accuracy -- a false-acceptance rate near 30% (system says 'I understand' when it only pattern-matched) is more dangerous than a lower raw accuracy score.
S0472: An inference problem must be constituted before a learning method can be selected. ... InferenceProblem: question, target, observations, representation, objective, loss, constraints, evaluation protocol.
S0721: The Zero Lens is an epistemic and architectural discipline that examines the boundary of a knowledge state ... while explicitly preventing those conditions from being interpreted as non-existence, falsity, invalidity, irrelevance or completeness. ... Zero is the lens that prevents the domain model from turning epistemic absence into a domain fact. ... ZERO PRINCIPLE: What is not represented is not thereby nonexistent.
S0757: Krishna belongs to Lord and at some condition can itself be the Lord. ... I would not yet formalize the statement "Krishna can itself be the Lord" as an architectural rule. That is a theological/metaphysical proposition ... we should not prematurely convert it into a KnowledgeOS invariant. ... the distinction between Krishna and the Lord may itself collapse. That last possibility is precisely the kind of thing the Lord Lens should investigate rather than assume.
S2243: Zero is the kernel's ability to represent the boundary between knowledge and non-knowledge.
S2416: ZERO PRINCIPLE: What is not represented is not thereby nonexistent. ... KnowledgeOS must preserve these distinctions rather than collapse them into a single unknown, null, false, invalid, or complete state.

ZL(K_t,I_t,Gamma_t,L_t) -> B_t ... Zero is the disciplined, inquiry-relative examination of what a current epistemic representation establishes, does not establish, and may fail to represent, while preserving distinctions among the different reasons for that boundary.
S2435: ZL(K_t,I_t,Gamma_t,L_t) -> B_t ... Boundary -> Tension -> Inquiry -> Interaction -> Reconciliation -> Closure -> Knowledge ... This makes the KnowledgeOS epistemic process cyclic rather than linear.
S2453: Kernel = Yoni is not accepted. Yoni is [EXT] -- a philosophical lens. There is no structure-preserving correspondence Yoni ≅ 𝒦 ... Also in force: Zero is a lens, not a state producer (Zero Concept v1.2 §3: Zero ≠ K_t).
S2727: Question-Relative Zero Principle (Research Principle) ... Zero_i(K_t | Q, T, Pi_i, C)
